section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the world was created with ten utterances to allow for the existence of a tangible reality and free choice, while the single utterance remains concealed within them to be revealed through divine service.
section.t: And this will be understood by prefacing what our sages, of blessed memory, said,
that the reason the creation of the world was with ten utterances
(even though it could have been created with one utterance)
is to exact punishment from the wicked etc. and to give good reward to the righteous etc.
And the explanation of this is known,
that if the coming into being were from one utterance,
the world would be utterly nullified,
[for even the world of Beriah,
which came into being from the utterance of "Bereishis" in the Sefirah of Malchus,
is not a true entity,
and certainly if the coming into being were from the single utterance of Chochmah or Kesser,
and all the more so from the Will before the tzimtzum,
then the worlds would be in ultimate nullification],
and consequently the matter of choice would not apply.
Therefore, creation was with ten particular utterances,
so that through this the creations become in the aspect of a yesh (an independent entity),
and the matter of choice applies to them
(and the matter of reward and punishment,
to exact punishment from the wicked and to give good reward to the righteous).
But,
since the coming into being from the aspect of the ten utterances is in the aspect of a yesh, to the extent that it is possible to choose the opposite,
therefore, in order that the intention of creation be completed,
that there be a revelation of G-dliness in the world and that the creations be nullified to G-dliness,
creation was therefore in a manner that initially the single utterance was drawn down, and from it ten particular utterances were particularized,
so that through this, the generality of the single utterance is concealed within the ten utterances,
and through the service of man,
he reveals the generality of the single utterance
(in all levels,
up to the Will before the tzimtzum)
within the ten utterances and within the world
that came into being from them,
so that there will be a revelation of G-dliness in the world and it will be nullified to G-dliness.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the light beyond relation to worlds was drawn first, so that it would be concealed within the light proportionate to the worlds, enabling the ultimate nullification of existence through divine service.
section.t: And based on this, it will also be understood that initially the light in the aspect of the revelation of the Essence, which is above relation to worlds, shone,
and specifically from it the light according to the measure of the worlds was drawn.
For it is known
that the nullification in the world that comes from the revelation of the light according to the measure of the worlds
is only the nullification of the yesh (the sense of independent existence),
since relative to this light they have a measure,
and the true matter of nullification,
nullification of existence,
is specifically from the light that is above relation to worlds.
And since the intention of creation is that the creations be nullified to G-dliness with ultimate nullification,
nullification of existence,
for specifically through this they become a dwelling place for Him, blessed be He,
therefore, there was first the light that is above relation to worlds,
and specifically from it the light according to the measure of the worlds was drawn,
so that through this, there is concealed within it also from the light that is above relation to worlds,
and as is known
that in the point of the reshimah (the impression left after tzimtzum) there is concealed
(not only all the particulars that will later be drawn down in the line,
but also)
from the innerness of the light that is above relation to worlds,
as in the analogy of a master and a student,
that in the point of the intellect of the master
(which remains with him at the time of the contraction)
there is concealed all the particulars that he will later influence to the student
(which are drawn from the externality of the intellect of the master),
and also from the innerness of the intellect of the master.
And since the particulars that are later drawn down, up to the ten utterances from which the world was actually created, are
(not a matter in itself,
but rather)
the particulars of the generality of the single utterance
(up to its first root)
in which there is concealed from the light that is above relation to worlds,
therefore,
through service,
they reveal within the ten utterances
(and within the world created from them)
not only the generality of the single utterance but also the light that is above relation to worlds
[and analogous to the analogy of the master and the student,
that through the student delving into the particulars,
he eventually becomes established in the mind of his master,
reaching the essential intellect of the master],
for through the revelation of this light,
it is drawn into the world that it be nullified to G-dliness with ultimate nullification,
nullification of existence.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that through service with the particulars, one reaches the aspect of the Essence of the light, which is above even the light beyond worlds that is concealed in the generality of the worlds.
section.t: And on a deeper level it can be said,
that through service with the particulars,
one reaches the aspect of the Essence of the light,
which is above even the light that is beyond worlds that exists concealed within the generality of the worlds.
For what is concealed within the generality of the worlds is the aspect of the spreading forth of the light,
that initially the Ein Sof light filled the void,
which is the light in the aspect of spreading forth and revelation,
and afterwards
(in this light)
it arose in His Will to emanate and create,
thus the relation of the Will to the worlds
(the generality of the worlds in its first root)
to the light of the boundless that is beyond worlds,
is only to the light in the aspect of spreading forth and revelation,
and through service with the particulars, one reaches the Essence of the light.
